title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one plant account separates a moving leaf from a daily opening flower
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Build a medieval plant-entry model that keeps two observed organs and two time scales apart: the leaf changes its direction in relation to the sun, while a named flower opens by day and closes at night. The already reviewed source family Pliny XXII.29, Dioscorides IV.190–191, and Isidore XVII.9.37 supplies these distinct source-side observations; the whole source passages, not selected phrases, are the unit. A future target reading would need one stable plant referent plus explicit attachment of leaf, flower, direction, and day/night phases. No matching complete admitted Voynich plant paragraph with those written roles is currently identified, so there is no target selection or new query. Rival: independent organ facts or a generic solar/flower catalogue, not one organism undergoing two kinds of change. This differs from one-flower day/night closure alone (IDEA680) and from one-organ sun-following alone (IDEA741); no meanings are assigned.

design.mechanism: An organism-level frame binds a directional leaf-motion predicate and a reversible flower-state predicate to different organs and different clocks; the same sun reference need not govern both relations.
design.unit: The complete source passages Pliny Natural History XXII.29, Dioscorides De materia medica IV.190–191, and Isidore Etymologiae XVII.9.37; eventual target unit must be one complete already-admitted herbal paragraph with all associated written groups, not an image-only resemblance.
design.contrast: Two attached organ-specific processes on one plant versus independent botanical catalogue facts, one general sun/flower label, or the single day/night flower cycle in IDEA680.
design.prediction: A future complete target construction must preserve one plant identity while attaching directional change to leaf and reversible day/night opening to flower; collapsing the relations into a single actor or one phase word fails the proposed model.
design.scope: Source-side construction proposal; no admitted target unit with the required role capacity has been identified. Exclude image-only plant matches and do not reopen IDEA621 or its f9v owner.
